fusions.name: Underfoot Edges
fusions.desc: Drives stone blades up through the ground around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking each 2 tiles back and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snapped Off Inside
fusions.desc: Stabs a target at or below 30% health for 20 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sown Shards
fusions.desc: Hides knapped flints at the nearest enemy. They wait up to 20 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles take 14 damage and are left [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Palmed Flint
fusions.desc: Conjures a flint blade. It increases your weapon damage by 12%, every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, and your armour rises by 5%.
